title: (RHBA-2025:15583) HawtIO Online 2.2.0 images for Red Hat build of Apache Camel 4 Release.
portal_summary: Updated HawtIO Online 2.2 images for Red Hat build of Apache Camel 4 Release.
portal_synopsis: HawtIO Online 2.2.0 images for Red Hat build of Apache Camel 4 Release.
portal_product_filter: Red Hat Build of Apache Camel|Red Hat Build of Apache Camel|1|x86_64
portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata
relevant to your system have been applied.

For details on how to apply this update, refer to:

https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258
portal_description:
This advisory makes the HawtIO Online 2.2.1 images for the Red Hat build of Apache Camel 4 available for Red Hat Integration. This is an update that addresses the folliowing issues:

* Issue regarding the permissions required for a non-admin user to access full capabilities of Hawtio-Online (HAWNG-1155)

* Issue regarding CVE-2025-22871 in the hawtio-operator-container: Request smuggling due to acceptance of invalid chunked data in net/http
